sentence: The room's organizing can be restated in the model's terms and none of the unused concepts shows organizing the model lacks or contradicts.

The room's organizing restates in the model's terms—calls and scripts (P01/P14), design and placement (P02/P04/P27), keeping and defence (P05/P08/P16), marking and record (P11/P12/P22), and thread coordination (P20/P23)—and the unused concepts (Bulls April Fools theme, thread vs chat) show nothing the model lacks or contradicts.
